generation.state: One initialization per stream. Preserve every generated word and hidden update. No forced punctuation or reset at sentence ends.
generation.decoder: Record exact decoder, temperature, features and seed entropy domain; do not silently mix branch and global-word temperatures.

continuity.2: recognizable setting but unstable facts or goals
continuity.4: clear development and meaningful ending without reset

voice.3: consistent adult first-person reflective or comic voice

quality_pass: All four dimensions at least3 on at least80% of all final-gate outputs, with no severe semantic loop or repeated paragraph across seeds. This is a chosen research criterion, not a validated industry metric.
automatic_checks: longest exact match against every training document
retained prefix facts with human interpretation
interpretation: No automatic metric alone proves grammar, originality or semantic continuity. Human scores must cite concrete output passages.
comparison: Review baseline and candidate using identical fixed seeds and decoder before looking at checkpoint labels. Keep all raw text and failed cases.
